title: 第15章 袁福通的选择帝辛的决定第16章 暴躁昊天在线发飙
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第15章袁福通的选择，帝辛的决定！“善待？”
帝辛听到袁福通的话后，只是冷冷地扫了他一眼，顿时吓得袁福通瑟瑟发抖地跪在地上。
下一刻，
铮！
一把散发着杀戮气息的刀，忽然插在袁福通面前三寸处，还不等他反应过来，就听到耳边传来东海龙王震惊无比的声音——
“这……这难道是传说中的先天灵宝，纵然是圣人要惧怕三分的斩仙诛神宝刀，大罗金仙被砍中，也会魂飞魄散的无上杀戮神兵？！”
东海龙王真的震惊了。
他做梦都想不到，帝辛竟然能得到这把绝世凶兵！
手持这把兵器，别说金仙，就算是昊天来了也不怕！
想到这里，
东海龙王震惊地看着帝辛，眼底深处更是出现狂热的崇拜之色！
但这一幕，并没有落入其他人的眼里，因为纵然是圣人，也看不到人皇内的景象！
这时，
帝辛双手负背，看着城东漫不经心道：“袁福通，孤赐你宝刀一柄，将他的头带回来亲手交给孤，若还是做不到的话，你和你的兄弟提头来见！”
“罪臣誓死完成任务！”
听到东海龙王的话，袁福通怎么不知道这把刀的威力。
然而更让袁福通激动的是，自己犯的乃是诛九族的死罪，可是人皇先是饶了自己及兄弟一命，之后又送阵旗、赐宝刀……
这种恩德，让抱着必死之心的袁福通，内心感动得一塌糊涂！
这一刻，
袁福通彻底归心帝辛，决定誓死效忠！

很快，
袁福通收起宝刀向着城外赶去，直到他的身影消失，闻仲等一众商臣，这才松了一口气。
这时，黄飞虎走出人群，抱拳道：“恭喜大王、贺喜大王，再收一员猛将！”
闻仲也抚着胡须看着帝辛，一脸敬佩道：“老臣也没想到，大王竟然能在这么短的时间内，就让袁福通归心，此乃大王之喜，大商之喜啊！”
“哈哈哈……这都是太师之功，接下来就让孤看看，这袁福通能不能用！”
帝辛笑道，但他的声音中，却充满了无尽自信和霸气。
……
与此同时，
袁福通一行三十六人出城，杀气腾腾地冲向那名来自天庭的金仙，
袁福通更是一马当先，指着半空中那名金仙破口大骂道：“天庭走狗，竟然敢来我朝歌城外大放厥词，今天我让你有来无回！”
“哼，区区半仙也敢来本座面前撒野，真是不知死活，蝼蚁般的东西，杀你们只会脏了本座的手，滚！”
天庭金仙只是扫了一眼众人，不屑地说到，压根就没把袁福通等人放在眼里。
三十六人，才五个半仙，给自己挠痒痒还差不多！
就在这名金仙不屑动手时，袁福通忽然大喊道：“布阵！”
哗啦啦……
随着他的话落，天罡阵旗忽然出现在他们手中，下一刻，三十六人身上的气息瞬间交织在一起，顷刻间吸收了方圆百里内的灵气。
紧接着，那股力量，直接灌入袁福通的体内！
轰隆！
一声巨响，本来正常人大小的袁福通，瞬间化作一尊十丈高的巨人，可怕的气势在他身上爆发，直接驱散了方圆十里的铅云！
元始天尊见状摇头道：“还以为这个人皇有什么本事，原来只是派个炮灰来送死！”

通天教主则叹息道：“以这些人的实力组成天罡阵，对付天仙还行，可要是对上金仙，那就必死无疑了，哎……人皇太不明智了！”
content_en:
Chapter 15 Yuan Futong’s choice, Di Xin’s decision! "Be kind?"
After Di Xin heard what Yuan Futong said, he just glanced at him coldly, and Yuan Futong was so frightened that he knelt on the ground trembling.
The next moment,
Zheng!
A knife exuding the aura of killing was suddenly inserted three inches in front of Yuan Futong. Before he could react, he heard the shocked voice of the Dragon King of the East China Sea -
"Is this... is this the legendary innate spiritual treasure, the immortal-killing sword that even a saint is afraid of? The supreme killing magic weapon that will disintegrate the Daluo Golden Immortal if it is struck?!"
The Dragon King of the East China Sea was really shocked.
He never dreamed that Di Xin would be able to obtain this unique weapon!
Holding this weapon, not to mention Jinxian, even if Haotian comes, he will not be afraid!
Thinking of this,
The Dragon King of the East China Sea looked at Di Xin in shock, with a look of fanatical admiration deep in his eyes!
But this scene did not fall into the eyes of others, because even the saints could not see the scene inside the Human Emperor!
At this time,
Di Xin put his hands behind his back, looked at Chengdong and said casually: "Yuan Futong, Gu will give you a sword. Bring his head back and hand it to Gu personally. If you still can't do it, you and your brother will come to see you!"
"The sinner swears to the death to complete the mission!"
Hearing what the Dragon King of the East China Sea said, why didn't Yuan Futong know the power of this sword?
However, what made Yuan Futong even more excited was that he had committed the death penalty of killing the nine tribes, but the Human Emperor first spared the lives of himself and his brothers, and then sent the formation flag and sword...
This kind of kindness made Yuan Futong, who was determined to die, so moved that he was completely moved inside!
At this moment,
Yuan Futong completely surrendered to Emperor Xin and decided to swear allegiance to him!
Soon,
Yuan Futong put away his sword and rushed out of the city. It was not until his figure disappeared that Wen Zhong and other merchants breathed a sigh of relief.
At this time, Huang Feihu walked out of the crowd, cupped his fists and said: "Congratulations to the king, congratulations to the king, we have recruited another powerful general!"
Wen Zhong also stroked his beard and looked at Emperor Xin, with admiration on his face: "I never expected that the king could make Yuan Futong return to his heart in such a short period of time. This is the joy of the king and the great merchant!"
"Hahaha... This is all the work of the Grand Master. Next, let me see if Yuan Futong can use it!"
Di Xin smiled, but his voice was full of endless confidence and domineering.
…
At the same time,
Yuan Futong and his party of thirty-six people came out of the city and rushed towards the golden immortal from heaven with murderous intent.
Yuan Futong took the lead, pointing at the golden immortal in mid-air and yelling: "Heavenly lackey, you dare to come and talk nonsense outside Chaoge City. I will make sure you never come back today!"
"Hmph, even a mere half-immortal dares to act wild in front of me. You really don't know how to live or die. You are like ants. Killing you will only dirty my hands. Get out!"
Tianting Jinxian just glanced at everyone and said disdainfully, not paying attention to Yuan Futong and others at all.
Thirty-six people, only five and a half immortals, enough to scratch their own itch!
Just when the Golden Immortal didn't bother to take action, Yuan Futong suddenly shouted: "Set up the formation!"
Wow…
As he finished speaking, the Tiangang formation flag suddenly appeared in their hands. The next moment, the auras of the thirty-six people were intertwined with each other, absorbing the spiritual energy within a hundred miles in an instant.
Immediately afterwards, that power poured directly into Yuan Futong's body!
Boom!
With a loud noise, Yuan Futong, who was originally the size of a normal human, instantly transformed into a ten-foot-tall giant. A terrifying aura erupted from his body, directly dispelling the lead cloud within a ten-mile radius!
Upon seeing this, Yuanshi Tianzun shook his head and said: "I thought this Human Emperor had any abilities, but it turns out he just sent a cannon fodder to die!"
The leader of Tongtian Cult sighed: "With the strength of these people, forming the Tiangang Formation, it is okay to deal with the Celestial Immortals, but if we fight against the Golden Immortals, we will definitely die. Alas... the Human Emperor is so unwise!"
